## Full Prompts Used

### logo-primary
Professional brand identity design, Swiss design principles. Create a pure abstract symbol for Shanghai Innovation Institute / SII with no text, no letters, no crest, no seal. White Field #FFFFFF background. The mark is a precise algorithmic signal aperture: modular square grid fragments and thin Infrastructure Silver #D7DDE5 keylines forming an open forward-facing field, with Intelligence Ink #1E2732 structural strokes and a single restrained Signal Cyan #00C8F5 path connecting several nodes. Include glass-layer translucency, mist-silver #F5F7FA panels, cool-gray #68727F micro shadows, subtle riverfront glass-curtain-wall inspiration from Shanghai West Bund, and networked mentor/partner node logic. Crisp vector-like edges, generous clear space, institutional calm with young experimental lab energy. No stock AI brain, no neural wallpaper, no shield, no laurel, no red blue gold academic palette, no dark cyberpunk.

### modular-signal-grid-kit
Professional brand identity system board using Swiss design principles for Shanghai Innovation Institute. Wide white canvas showing the modular signal-glass-grid kit: left column displays grid spacing, thin keyline rules, glass card layering, node styles, metadata labels; center shows a large white and mist-silver #F5F7FA modular field with Infrastructure Silver #D7DDE5 lines and one active Signal Cyan #00C8F5 route; right column shows examples of content modules for research, recruitment, event, and admissions. Use Intelligence Ink #1E2732 headings, Cool Gray #68727F labels, compact monospaced metadata, modern bilingual grotesk typography. Cultural motifs: Shanghai West Bund glass curtain walls, open-source version trails, five AI frontier fields as abstract modular cells. Add faint glass refraction only, no rainbow gradients. No people, no campus photo, no cyberpunk darkness, no generic neural network wallpaper.

### research-release-card
Create a polished research release card template for Shanghai Innovation Institute, white-first digital-system design. Landscape 16:9 interface card on White Field #FFFFFF with mist-silver #F5F7FA glass panels, Infrastructure Silver #D7DDE5 grid lines, Intelligence Ink #1E2732 hierarchy, Cool Gray #68727F metadata, and a single Signal Cyan #00C8F5 active path. Exact visible English text: “Research Release”, “AI Infrastructure / Embodied Intelligence”, “SII-OS v0.3”, “Paper · Code · Benchmark”, “DATA → MODEL → VALUE”. Include abstract code layers, repository metadata, small benchmark chart, version trail, and four modular nodes representing cognitive, contextual, embodied, scientific intelligence. Modern sans-serif plus compact monospaced captions. Shanghai West Bund glass-lab mood, institutional calm, sharp youth innovation. No stock scientists, no fake logo clutter, no dark AI hero, no full-rainbow gradient, no university crest.

### talent-recruitment-hero
Design a desktop landing-page hero module for Shanghai Innovation Institute global talent recruitment, professional brand UI, white-based signal-glass-grid direction. Wide 16:9 composition with top navigation, left text hierarchy, and right translucent modular signal field. Use exact text: “CALLING FOR MARVELLERS”, “Young Faculty & Postdoctoral Fellows”, “From 0 to 1 AI Frontiers”, CTA buttons “Apply Now” and “Explore Labs”. Palette: White #FFFFFF, Mist Silver #F5F7FA glass cards, Infrastructure Silver #D7DDE5 lines, Intelligence Ink #1E2732 headings, Cool Gray #68727F metadata, one Signal Cyan #00C8F5 active CTA and route. Cultural motifs: networked mentor/partner collaboration, Shanghai West Bund glass curtain walls, five AI frontier fields as modular cards. Modern bilingual grotesk, restrained monospaced labels. No people, no stock campus, no heavy cyberpunk, no red-blue-gold academic palette, no rainbow tech gradient.

### lecture-techfest-poster
Create a high-impact but restrained vertical event key visual for Shanghai Innovation Institute, “Innovation Forum / TechFest”. Professional poster design, Swiss grid, white-first glass system. Canvas uses White Field #FFFFFF and Mist Silver #F5F7FA layered translucent panels; thin Infrastructure Silver #D7DDE5 signal grid rises vertically like a research tower; one precise Signal Cyan #00C8F5 pulse crosses nodes. Exact visible text: “SII TECHFEST”, “Innovation Forum”, “Frontier AI · Open Research · Industry Value”, “2026.06 / Shanghai West Bund”. Use Intelligence Ink #1E2732 bold modern grotesk title, Cool Gray #68727F metadata and compact monospaced schedule chips. Cultural motifs: riverfront glass curtain walls, modular teams, open-source version trails, five AI frontier fields. No dark cyberpunk stage, no lecturer stock photo, no generic neural brain, no crest, no red/blue/gold academic palette, no rainbow gradient.

### admissions-info-template
Design a structured admissions information template for Shanghai Innovation Institute summer camp / doctoral selection, not a generic school ad. Landscape 16:9 white digital notice with modular signal-glass-grid layout. Use exact visible English text: “Summer Research Camp”, “Doctoral Selection Information”, “Dates / Requirements / Process / Register”, “Step 01 Eligibility”, “Step 02 Materials”, “Step 03 Test”, “Step 04 Interview”. Palette: White #FFFFFF, Mist Silver #F5F7FA glass sections, Infrastructure Silver #D7DDE5 separators, Intelligence Ink #1E2732 headings, Cool Gray #68727F captions, Signal Cyan #00C8F5 CTA and progress line. Include calendar chip, checklist module, process timeline, QR placeholder, open-source metadata styling, and subtle Shanghai West Bund glass-lab cues. Modern bilingual grotesk with monospaced small labels. No smiling students, no campus hero, no brochure look, no crest, no red-blue-gold university palette, no dark cyberpunk.
